content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Digital product

A digital product store with no-KYC payments enables creators to sell their work without the barriers imposed by conventional payment systems. This infrastructure allows you to accept cryptocurrency payments, ensuring instant transactions and low fees. Unlike platforms like Gumroad that charge hefty percentages on each sale, implementing solutions like NOWPayments only incurs a 0.5% fee. This means greater profits for creators, particularly for those selling high-ticket items such as courses or software, where every dollar matters.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture of a no-KYC digital product store relies on a combination of free tools and blockchain technology. Hosting can be achieved through platforms like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, while backend logic is managed by Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. Order storage can be handled by Supabase or Google Sheets. By integrating NOWPayments, creators can automate crypto payment processing, verifying transactions in real-time. This stack provides a solid foundation that is not only cost-effective but also scalable for future growth.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This solution is designed for digital creators in regions where traditional payment gateways are either unavailable or cumbersome. If you are selling ebooks, courses, templates, or digital assets and have been struggling with payment processing, this infrastructure is for you. It empowers creators in Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, Venezuela, and other markets to operate independent of major platforms, fostering financial sovereignty. By choosing this route, you regain control over your business operations and finances.
Reduce transaction fees and keep more profit with NOWPayments.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The key components of this digital product store include hosting, backend processing, order management, and payment processing. Hosting can be achieved through GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, offering reliable and free services. The backend is powered by Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, which handle the logic for managing orders. For storage, Supabase or Google Sheets serve as the database. Finally, NOWPayments facilitates seamless cryptocurrency transactions, allowing you to accept payments efficiently while retaining maximum earnings.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To get started with your own no-KYC digital product store, first select a hosting platform like GitHub Pages. Next, set up your backend logic using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script to manage transactions. Choose Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage and integrate NOWPayments for processing crypto payments. You can find all the necessary resources and templates in the Complete Builder Kit ($197) to streamline your deployment process. Start building your sovereign stack today and take control of your digital sales.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

To sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe, you can establish your own digital product store using cryptocurrency payment solutions like NOWPayments. This method eliminates the need for KYC and platform fees, allowing you to keep more of your revenue. With tools like GitHub Pages and Cloudflare Workers, you can build a fully functional store that operates independently.
Own your infrastructure and eliminate reliance on third-party platforms.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

If you’re looking for a comprehensive solution to sell digital products without relying on conventional platforms, explore the Complete Builder Kit ($197). It provides all the necessary blueprints and templates to establish your store effectively. You can find more details at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Build your product before you build your store — the product is the point, not the infrastructure. Once your product is ready and in delivery-ready format, create your NOWPayments account and configure wallet addresses. Choose Stack 01 for self-deployment following the Blueprint, or Stack 02 for COREMERCH deployment. Upload your product file to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 and note the file path. Configure the product in your backend with the file path, USD price, and delivery email template. Build your product page on the storefront with clear product description, pricing in USD, and the checkout flow. Run a complete mainnet test. Check that the download link works and expires correctly after the configured time period.

You can sell your ebook by creating a digital product store that uses a cryptocurrency payment solution like NOWPayments. This eliminates the need for PayPal or Stripe while allowing you to retain a larger portion of your sales.

The best way is to set up your own store using free hosting services and integrate NOWPayments for payment processing. This approach significantly reduces transaction fees compared to platforms like Gumroad, which charge around 10%.

Yes, you can sell templates and fonts by establishing a digital store with a no-KYC payment setup. Utilizing tools like Cloudflare Workers and NOWPayments allows you to manage sales independently.
What are the advantages of using NOWPayments?
NOWPayments offers low transaction fees of 0.5%, supports over 300 cryptocurrencies, and requires no KYC. This enables creators to receive payments directly and efficiently.
How can I manage my orders efficiently?
You can manage orders using Supabase or Google Sheets, which provide a straightforward way to track sales, customer data, and delivery processes, ensuring everything runs smoothly.
